name: Johnson Fine Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Johnson Fine Chemical Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies amine-based and isocyanate-based hardenders/curing agents for use in casting, adhesive, sealant, and elastomer fields. It offers specialty chemicals, such as amine curing agents, isocyanate curing agents, isocyanate crosslinkers, dehydrating agents, and coating system. The company also provides polyaspartic polyurea resin, anti-UV cooling topcoats, and zinc epoxy primer; and PU waterproof materials, PU track/court materials, PU sealants/non-drip mid-coats, PU joint fillers, PU flooring coats, anti-UV cooling topcoats, and PU heat resistant topcoats.
